reasoning: On the season so far the Cavaliers are the stronger team; with home court the Cavaliers start about 4 points better, in a game of about 243 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Bulls.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bulls (revenge, confidence).
Bottom line: the Cavaliers win 57 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 217 and 266 total points.
